description: Two mults in 2HP, each copying one input to four outputs, and chaining into one input to eight outputs when the lower input is left empty

inputs.text: The signal that section copies; with the lower jack empty that section reads the upper one

outputs.text: A copy of that section's input, with the same number of channels

notes: the module has no controls at all; the only setting is the output clipping range on the menu
the copy appears one processing cycle after the input, which can be used deliberately as a one-cycle delay
menu: Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.1:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the upper input.
